apps.name: Train Sim World® 6: Schnellfahrstrecke Köln - Aachen Remastered Route Add-On
apps.short_description: Re-experience the thrill of high-speed rail in the exquisite Train Sim World®: Schnellfahrstrecke Köln - Aachen, now fully remastered in a free update! Operate mixed-traffic services and take in the new volumetric skies, enhanced foliage and more.

apps.name: VRacer Hoverbike - Kepler
apps.short_description: Ride the KEPLER track in all game modes! If you host a multiplayer sessions, you can use this track even if other players don't own it.

apps.name: VRacer Hoverbike - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Support the devs, and get exclusive props to shine in multiplayer and on the leaderboards.

apps.name: 挂机魔王 II - 无尽狩猎·成长扩展
apps.short_description: Hunt monsters in new areas, earn Hunting XP, raise your Hunting Level and shape your build with specializations. Face elites and bosses, improve your farming efficiency and unlock milestone rewards. Requires Idle Demon Lord II.

apps.name: 13th Ball: The Nightmare Shift
apps.short_description: Working the night shift at a rundown pool bar sounds simple enough: rack tables, serve drinks, mop floors. But when reality begins to twist at the corner of your vision, your sanity is put to the test. Will you succumb to your deepest fears, or survive to clock in again tomorrow?

apps.name: 3D Bumper Billiards
apps.short_description: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

apps.name: A Game About Collecting Souls
apps.short_description: An incremental game about collecting souls, slaying villagers and becoming a powerful Dark Warlock! All to save your daughter.

apps.name: Akasha's Corridor
apps.short_description: Three modern girls, each harboring unique psychological trauma, fall into a world that is as cruel as it is alluringly perverse. This is an adult Roguelike adventure game that combines high-difficulty combat with fragmented storytelling.

apps.name: All That Junk
apps.short_description: A first-person junkyard sorting game. Lift scrap with a gravity gun, then build a factory of belts, cranes, magnets, screens, shakers and eddy separators that sorts steel, copper, aluminium, lead, plastic and rubber by what they feel: size, weight, magnetism and conductivity.

apps.name: Amberly Holllow
apps.short_description: A Life Sim RPG set in an isolated village. Train and master a variety of skills, collecting resources and rewards as you complete quests, upgrade your home, and discover the secrets of the village of Amberly.

apps.name: Arcane Surge
apps.short_description: Arcane Surge is a top-down action roguelike about fast spellcasting and precise dodges. Build a loadout from spells and relics, read the attacks of dungeon enemies, and look for the right opening to unleash your strongest spell.

apps.name: Ardor for Depravity
apps.short_description: A story driven visual novel with sandbox elements. Heavy focus on corruption and psychological transformation, with adult scenes, themes and elements. A story of Emily and her journey towards discovering her true nature.

apps.name: Argosy
apps.short_description: Buy low, sail far, sell high. A medieval trading sim with a living economy: build routes, factories and fleets, outwit rival merchants, and rise from humble trader to lord mayor and beyond. Play solo or online.

apps.name: Artificial Violet
apps.short_description: A visual novel about identity and validation on social media. Step into Violeta's shoes and make decisions that will define who you really are.

apps.name: Asa's Ascended
apps.short_description: A boss-rush bullethell with custom bosses made by the community!

apps.name: Attack Only
apps.short_description: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.

apps.name: Augment Mahjong
apps.short_description: A single & multiplayer game blending Riichi Mahjong with a rule-breaking Augment system. Acquire cards each round to override the board's rules. Combine System Overrides and your Augments to create powerful synergies! Enjoy this thrilling variant with friends or sophisticated AI.

apps.name: BARI
apps.short_description: BARI is a bullet heaven action game where you fight alongside another you. Survive endless threats with the “Meari,” doubles that remember your play style. Every run you finish becomes your next ally.

apps.name: Battle Vest Metal Quest
apps.short_description: Battle Vest Metal Quest is an action strategy hybrid game with rogue-lite elements. Build the ultimate Heavy Metal Battle Vest and then take it into battle against swarms of crazed enemies and ultimate Metal bosses. Buy and equip new patches that unleash new abilities, and minions.

apps.name: BE QUICK! The Rise of Fraya
apps.short_description: A cinematic QTE boss rush built around reflexes and precision. Track moving targets, maintain your combo, develop eleven attributes and guide Queen Fraya through 17 champions to challenge the god Mayinalli.

apps.name: BEYOND TENMEI
apps.short_description: Cast dice. Cast spells. Cast down your fate. God runs be damned.

apps.name: Big Cock Inc.
apps.short_description: A cozy farm sim where you arm your cocks with AK-47s and bet the rent on them in club fights. Breed the best chickens, steal and sell their eggs, send the rest down the conveyor to the fryer, and serve them through your own fried chicken drive-thru.

apps.name: Big Pig Dig
apps.short_description: A tower defense where thousands of pigs pour out of their dens. Place your turrets, then dig, drill and blast to break the stampede. Every tool reshapes the ground and redirects the herd. Each pig you stop is gold for a bigger arsenal.

apps.name: Bitnook
apps.short_description: Your desktop is now a battlefield! Summon adorable digital heroes, build a powerful army, and fight off endless waves of bugs. Upgrade your units, discover powerful combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this charming desktop idle RPG!

apps.name: Blast Front Azul Sol Force
apps.short_description: Fire three weapon systems at once in a side-scrolling shooter across 3D seas, skies and space. Choose your loadout, upgrade your craft and take branching routes. Destroy enemy formations, shoot down destructible bullets and keep your combo going to beat your personal best.

apps.name: BlightMist Idle
apps.short_description: Every drop feeds something. Ore becomes ingots becomes gear becomes power. Monster parts become permanent power. Seven classes, six life skills (just in Act 1 alone), talent trees,  card collection, and much more — all compounding, while you're on and offline.

apps.name: Borderlands GOTY
apps.short_description:
Get ready for the mind blowing insanity!  Play as one of four trigger-happy mercenaries and take out everything that stands in your way!
With its addictive action, frantic first-person shooter combat, massive arsenal of weaponry, RPG elements and four-player co-op, Borderlands is a breakthrough experience that challenges all the conventions of modern shooters.

apps.name: BR - Brazilian Survival
apps.short_description:
BR - Brazilian Survival is an action-adventure game with survival elements, set in a semi-open world inspired by Brazil.

Collect and manage resources, level up, hunt and eliminate all infected and other enemies scattered across the map, trade with merchants, and upgrade your arsenal.

apps.name: Broken Shell
apps.short_description: Broken Shell is a short, hand-drawn puzzle adventure about two hermit crabs searching for a place to call home. Explore a vibrant underwater world, solve gentle puzzles, and experience a heartfelt story told entirely without words.

apps.name: Caesura
apps.short_description: Explore caves, forest, and clouds to discover new secrets in the mysterious world of Caesura. A rhythm driven, hand drawn world. Match your jumps and dashes to the beat to solve challenging puzzles that ask you to dance along with the world as it also dances to the beat.

apps.name: Calamity Quarry
apps.short_description: A meteor has fallen. You're here to mine it. Rest your cursor on the stone, grow your devices through a sprawling skill map, and invoke the next calamity. What falls next, we won't tell you. Pray.

apps.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth
apps.short_description: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

apps.name: Card Make Arena
apps.short_description:
Create. Build. Duel you
CardMakeArena is a next-generation card game where you craft your own cards from scratch—then face a real opponent across the table.

Design everything freely: effects, targets, timing, even the artwork. Then bring the deck that's yours alone… and it's you and me.

apps.name: Castle Crash Online
apps.short_description: Castle Crash Online is a 1v1 strategy game where you and your opponent are dropped into an empty forest at the start of every round. Each player slowly builds a large and complex settlement full of houses, farms, troops, and workshops. Create a powerful army and siege the enemy fortress!

apps.name: Catfight
apps.short_description: Team up with a catgirl companion in 2v2 deathmatch tournaments, then head back to the apartment you share. Talk through your microphone and hear her reply, coordinate in combat, and spend your winnings on guns, outfits, and home decorations. Her AI runs locally on your PC.

apps.name: Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball
apps.short_description:
This is a very short game 🥳

We've hidden 200 cats inside a silent comic about a calico cat chasing a yarn ball all around the house. Can you find them all? 🔎🙀

apps.name: Catto Pew Pew! CLASSIC
apps.short_description: Catto Pew Pew! CLASSIC is a chaotic physics-based arena shooter where your shots cause your opponent to fly backward. Join the chaos for free!

apps.name: Cave Diving With Friends
apps.short_description: Cave Diving With Friends is a chaotic co-op adventure for up to six players (but still fun alone!). Pick your mission and difficulty, squeeze through cramped passages, explore unpredictable procedurally generated caves, survive against enemies, help your friends, and don't get lost in the dark.

apps.name: Censer Infinite
apps.short_description: Smash spirits and demons in this fast-paced, low-poly hack and slash adventure! Play as a mace-wielding angel and find a way to return home to the gates of Eden. Upgrade your censer, conquer cinematic boss fights and exorcise the source of the Blight.

apps.name: Chaos Rider
apps.short_description: The crazy plan to revive an ancient spirit has finally succeeded. The Chaos Rider is here to restore an age of magic to this fallen world. With a powerful adaptive robotic body and ancient powers, explore, forge alliances, conquer foes and challenges, and uncover countless secrets and wonders.

apps.name: Checkmate Heroines
apps.short_description: Anime arrives to chess! And with new technology! Improve your skills with the game analysis tool at no extra cost, and test them against players around the globe and even your friends. Including those who don’t own the game! May your kingdom thrive!

apps.name: Chinese-Style Exams
apps.short_description: How would you score today? Chinese-Style Exams is a nostalgic single-player exam simulator. Work your way from Grade 1 to Grade 12 through Chinese, math, and English exams, review your scores and feedback, and try again as you work toward China's high school and university entrance exams.

apps.name: Chuzzle 2
apps.short_description: Slide and match colorful chuzzles, put three together, and watch them sneeze, shiver and explode with delight! But watch out for locks and other dangers as you take on dozens of Chuzzle challenges in your quest to funkify the universe!

apps.name: CircuitGig
apps.short_description: Drive, deliver, and fight through escalating city shifts in this top-down action roguelite. Pair vehicles with couriers, shape Ballistic, Electrical, and Fire builds, and survive the route to finish the job.

apps.name: Clonefall
apps.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where your clones are part of the solution. Create clones to reach new places, block hazards, activate mechanisms, and manipulate physics to overcome each challenge.

apps.name: Coalateral Damage
apps.short_description: Run your own rat-infested, dusty, dangerous coal mine. Race the shift clock, hit the weekly quota and keep the debt down. Every shift counts. Dodge inspectors, cave-ins, copper thieves and some very shady business. Uncover rare gems, schematics, collectibles, and more!

apps.name: Coffinmaker
apps.short_description: Inherit Velvet & Pine, a little coffin shop that has secretly served vampires for sixty years. Greet the night's customers, work out who casts no reflection, and build bespoke coffins by hand for the undead.

apps.name: Convoy Inc.
apps.short_description: Build a freight empire on a watercolor-style map of the real world. Start in 1980, 2000 or 2030 with one truck and one driver, take jobs across 207 countries, weather storms, rivals and tired drivers, and grow a fleet where every risk is visible before you take it.

apps.name: Cosa Nostra – The Dark Empire
apps.short_description: From errand boy to godfather: build a criminal empire of protection rackets, moonshine and smuggling in a rain-soaked city, buy officials, wage war on six families and keep the heat down. Turn-based mafia strategy with chained events and multiple endings.

apps.name: CounterMind
apps.short_description: A planetary RTS against an adaptive enemy that learns how you play. Lead machine legions or the hive swarm across ground, sea, air, and space. The enemy doesn't cheat. It plays smarter. Can you outsmart the opposing minds?

apps.name: Coup de Koala
apps.short_description: Seize back the crown in Coup de Koala, a cute bullet hell roguelite of furious rebellion. As an exiled koala king, unleash spells and steel against relentless undead legions to reclaim your throne. Build your deck of cards, die, upgrade your character, repeat.

apps.name: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
apps.short_description: Play as Axel in an all-new, high-octane adventure as he sets out to recover his stolen taxi and chase down a mysterious organization causing chaos around the world. Race through iconic locations and tackle extreme missions in the long-awaited return of the classic series.

apps.name: Cursed Fishing Simulator
apps.short_description: Catch strange fish, discover bizarre mutations, and build your own fishing empire. Explore new locations, upgrade your equipment, and fill your aquarium with the weirdest creatures the ocean has to offer. What could possibly go wrong?

apps.name: Dark Fantasy Vault
apps.short_description: Build a refuge with your friends in a dark fantasy world consumed by war. Restore and decorate an ancient vault, shelter travelers, and run your own shop. Venture into the wilderness to fight monsters and gather resources in this co-op adventure for 2–4 players.

apps.name: DARK IN LIGHT
apps.short_description: A man who falls asleep while working late wakes up in an unfamiliar city overrun by monsters. Survive with limited resources and explore the city by following clues through the darkness. You must press on to make it back to the son waiting for you.

apps.name: Dash Flash Rush
apps.short_description: Move at high speed across 2D platforms, dodge attacks, and take down enemies—then join a smoking-headed guy and step into an absurd story.

apps.name: Dear Polder
apps.short_description: The sea took half your fields. Dear Polder is a cozy farming life sim in a Dutch polder village, solo or in 4-player online co-op. Mend the dike, let your windmill pump the land dry, then befriend 40 villagers and dance under the lanterns on festival nights.

apps.name: Denied Ground
apps.short_description: DENIED GROUND is a modern tactical military shooter featuring intense infantry combat, competitive arcade modes, and large-scale milsim operations. Fight together, coordinate your squad, and adapt to an evolving battlefield where every decision matters.

apps.name: Die Lucky
apps.short_description: From picking locks to slipping past patrols, every heist plays out as a tactical dice-and-deck challenge where wit is what tames your dicebag's RNG chaos. You are a thief named Chance Dallow. Sassy, sarcastic, a bit irresponsible, and absolutely certain that consequences only happen to other people.

apps.name: Dino Epoch: Fantasy Tale
apps.short_description: 《Dino Epoch Fantasy Tale》A boy who chases mythical beasts in ring-toss adventures explores a brand-new world of fantasy creatures, awakens dormant unknown powers, captures companions across the uncharted realm, uncovers the technological secrets of this fantasy world, builds an ideal homeland.

apps.name: Divinos: Ardor of the Forest
apps.short_description: A metroidvania crossed with a visual novel, Divinos is a 2D action-adventure platformer with narrative driven gameplay. Explore the world, uncover secrets and strengthen your character with unlockable special abilities to help you in combat and exploration.

apps.name: Dream Riders
apps.short_description: Dream Riders is a fast-paced 2.5D auto runner driving sim set in a hand-drawn dreampop pixel world. Take on a series of high-speed boss encounters each lurking behind a themed high difficulty track, or just see how far you can drive.  Prove that nothing is off limits if you're fast enough!

apps.name: DreamWar Siege
apps.short_description: One Dreamer. One Nightmare. An asymmetric war where one player fights through thousands of demons as an action-roguelite hero, and the other commands them in real time: building, spawning, forging towers and corrupting the land. Play solo vs AI, online PvP, co-op or ranked.

apps.name: Dress to Work: Desk Dolls
apps.short_description: Build your own chibi girl from 230+ recolorable parts and let her live on your desktop! Dress her for the right job and she'll go to work and earn coins on her own. When you start typing, she steps up to a desk beside you and types along.

apps.name: Drift Signal
apps.short_description: Build a growing spacecraft and follow unknown signals through deep space. Gather and process resources, arrange machinery within limited space, expand your compartments, and automate repetitive work. Keep your mobile home running and prepare for the next leg of your voyage.

apps.name: Dub With Friends
apps.short_description: Dub With Friends is an online party game where you and your friends dub video clips with your own voices. Pick a clip, record your lines, then watch the ridiculous results together. Discover and share new clips through the Steam Workshop.

apps.name: Dump Chaos
apps.short_description: Dig through piles of junk, place the items you find on their proper shelves, and sell them to make money. Take your time organizing, add rare finds to your collection, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning chaos into order.

apps.name: Dungeon Escape 3
apps.short_description:
Explore the maze. Collect the gems. Uncover its secrets.

Dungeon Escape 3 is a 2D top-down maze escape game featuring over 30 levels to explore, hidden collectibles to discover, and puzzles to solve. Navigate through a maze of interconnected rooms, unlock new paths, and see how far you can go.

apps.name: Dungeons With Friends
apps.short_description: Dungeons With Friends is a co-op roguelike where you and your friends shout spells into your microphones to fight through a tower full of evil robots.

apps.name: Dylio's Adventures
apps.short_description: Imagine waking up transformed into an armadillo after fleeing an indescribable trauma. Step into Dylio’s shell and venture through dimensional portals and perilous paths to recover the treasures stolen by a mysterious crow… and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

apps.name: Edge of the Blade | 칼 끝에 서서
apps.short_description: Command your legion in a war-torn land of blood and steel. A roguelite grand-strategy autobattler: lead one of three legions across Cheonggu, capture strongholds week by week, build your deck, and clash in real-time auto battles. In Story Mode, your choices decide who lives and dies

apps.name: Eggcellent Guess
apps.short_description: A silly online party game for up to 12 friends. Everyone can read the word on your egg's headband except you. Ask questions, listen to the clues and guess it before the stopwatch gets away from you. Fastest total time wins.

apps.name: Elixir of Moonglow
apps.short_description: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

apps.name: Em the Emissary
apps.short_description:
Join Em the Emissary in an adventure to restore the hearts of his friends, in a cute 3D platformer!  
After Dis the Disciple was given the Scales of Ma'at, the jackal began weighing everyone's hearts without any counterbalance, forcing beings into a state of unrest and in need of saving.

apps.name: Embroideryvania
apps.short_description: You always wanted to visit. Now you have the time and a friend, but no map. Getting lost is highly encouraged.

apps.name: Enderal: Forgotten Stories
apps.short_description: Enderal: Forgotten Stories is a total conversion mod for Skyrim that is set in its own world with its own lore and story. It offers an immersive open world, all for the player to explore, overhauled skill systems and gameplay mechanics and a dark, psychological storyline with believable characters.

apps.name: Endless Estate
apps.short_description: A spooky multiplayer game where you draft rooms to escape a haunted mansion.

apps.name: Evenicle - Next Fragment Medica
apps.short_description: In a world where human civilization is threatened by monsters, only the rare few individuals who wield forbidden skills dare challenge them. However, these brave warriors have to face an even more dangerous hazard... The Hero Syndrome. Only a young doctor can hope to cure the disease in this JRPG!

apps.name: Everrest
apps.short_description: A boy drifts into a dream that doesn't want to let him go. Armed with a pillow and a wish, climb through misty forests, golden groves, and crumbling castles in this isometric action roguelite, and face the Fears that keep him asleep.

apps.name: Farm Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A thousand loose animals. One very untidy farm. Sort mixed herds, lead each species home and turn crowded paths into open space in this first-person organizing game. Combine and upgrade your tools, find the last stragglers and keep the wolves away.

apps.name: FATAL HEELZ
apps.short_description:
Third-person, cyberpunk-vampire brutal action game.
Play as Silo, a female vampire-assassin. Kill your target and uncover the secrets behind the organization you work for.

apps.name: Fired
apps.short_description: FIRED is a retro-styled puzzle adventure game centered around the story of a young employee who gets FIRED while trying to expose the evil Orcus Corporation. Explore the world, solve puzzles, and work to take down Orcus.

apps.name: Fool King
apps.short_description: Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat!

apps.name: Formula Minus One
apps.short_description: Formula Minus One is an arcade anti-gravity racer. Pilot futuristic ships, master spectacular circuits, and combine racing lines, slipstreaming, and turbos to outpace your rivals. When the going gets tough, use your boost to ram opponents in kinetic combat.

apps.name: GAMBALL
apps.short_description: Introducing GAMBALL, an intense multiplayer PvP strategy and gambling game that pushes players to their limit. Set in an abandoned missile silo, take turns removing rebar from the silo until the ball comes plummeting down. Only one player can win.

apps.name: Girls Summon
apps.short_description: Girls Summon is a beautifully crafted idle card game where you collect and nurture characters.

apps.name: God of Stocks
apps.short_description:
An incremental management game about manipulating the market to get filthy rich.
Buy low, sell high, chain absurd combos and earn divine blessings from stock market gods. Will you play it safe or risk everything?

apps.name: Golem Survival
apps.short_description:
Golem Survival is a game where survival isn’t the only goal for you and your friends (eventually). Your real goal is to reclaim the lost world, one town at a time.
Gather materials to build, shards to research, and Golems to help you fight back and reclaim the land!

apps.name: GOLF+
apps.short_description: Tee off at Pebble Beach, St Andrews, TPC Sawgrass, and over 40 other legendary courses. True-to-life swing physics, cross-platform multiplayer, and global competition on the GOLF+ TOUR. Gear up with Callaway, TaylorMade, Swag Golf and more.

apps.name: Good Boy Good Waves
apps.short_description: Set out on a relaxing paddleboard journey across scenic island waters with your faithful canine companion. Catch the rhythm of gentle waves, balance your board, explore peaceful coastlines, and uncover tranquil island secrets together.

apps.name: Gooner
apps.short_description: Gooner is a MMO-style RPG and turn-based strategy game blended into a singular "goon-pilled" package. Embark on an epic gooning adventure! Experience an enthralling story, exhilarating boss mechanics, and a seemingly endless array of naughty pixel art animations.

apps.name: GtFckd
apps.short_description: Survive the horde on a tiny planet, alone or with up to 3 friends. Pick one of 12 ridiculous champions, stack spells that cast themselves, gamble on slot-machine chests, bargain with shrines and hunt secrets while a boss lands every three minutes.

apps.name: Guardians: A Wardens Tale
apps.short_description: Guardians: A Wardens Tale is a Monster Taming/Dungeon crawling game. Progress through dungeons in each town to help the locals. Fight other Guardian tamers and Alpha Guardians in Active Time Battles with your team of 5.

apps.name: Happy Project 12
apps.short_description: Become the father of Hinata, a 4th-grader, and face three years of junior high entrance exams. Each week, choose study or play, raise her deviation score, aim for her dream school. But what's really being tested is your relationship, not her grades. Which of the 11 endings awaits you?

apps.name: Hard Recall
apps.short_description: Los Ceniza, after midnight. Halvorsen's household androids have turned on their owners, and Meridian Mutual pays on every recall. Lead a squad of claims operators, solo or with up to three friends, through rain-soaked neon streets in a twin-stick noir shooter where every block is new.

apps.name: Heroes of Might and Magic III: Horn of the Abyss
apps.short_description: Horn of the Abyss is a widely acclaimed fan-made expansion pack for the legendary Heroes of Might & Magic III turn-based strategy. Introduces HD graphics, three new factions, five lore-rich campaigns and a wealth of other gameplay and QoL additions and enhancements.

apps.name: High School Otome
apps.short_description: Sabrina is your average teenager. However she has a troubled relationship with her grandmother, who is her only family guardian after her parents died in a car accident. Things only get worse when Sabrina hears the devastating news that her Grandmother has cancer.

apps.name: Hillthorn
apps.short_description: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.

apps.name: HOLD THE COOP!
apps.short_description: HOLD THE COOP! is an incremental auto-battler where you protect your coop from waves of coyotes. Earn gold, buy upgrades, unlock stronger chicken units, and survive tougher rounds. Lose, upgrade, and come back stronger!

apps.name: HOMEWARD:Ark
apps.short_description: HOMEWARD: Ark is a meticulously crafted horror extraction shooter. As a survivor of the apocalypse, you take on the role of "Dove," sneaking into perilous locations to scavenge supplies, hunt for clues, and battle the Infected, all while building up the Ark—humanity's home.

apps.name: Hook Nook
apps.short_description: A cozy multiplayer idle-fishing game that sits on the bottom of your screen. Catch fish to unlock different biomes, socialize with shopkeepers, upgrade your gear, and maybe even try wearing a duck for a hat! Study, work or watch shorts while fishing with friends.

apps.name: Horde Reapers
apps.short_description: Face hordes and bosses, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Shape your build with weapons, items, and elemental powers, then bring resources back to rebuild your village and unlock permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Hunt for the Lost Folktales
apps.short_description: A folklore hunting, turn-based battling, creature collector adventure where you follow trails to hunt escaped folktale beasts, engage in strategic tactical battles where fear is your strength, and capture the lost folktales so they may live on in memory. Will you be another folktale to be written?

apps.name: Imp Pact
apps.short_description: An incremental where an ageing man who cannot read makes his mark on an imp's contract, puts the imps to work on the rats in his cellar, and is billed for the trial period. Keep the interest current, in blood, every forty-five seconds, or he takes imps back, and is apologetic about it.

apps.name: In Your Dreams
apps.short_description: A short survival horror experience where you must elude a bloodthirsty shape-shifting beast. Created in one month for spooky season!

apps.name: Infinite Elevator
apps.short_description: Ride the elevator down, study the same hallway floor after floor, and decide if something has changed. See something strange, press up. See nothing, go down. Get to the ground floor and escape the nightmare.

apps.name: INKarnation
apps.short_description: Turn your doodles into fighters! Draw your own characters in INKarnation, then battle online, race through Time Attack, test your drawing skills in Sketch Rush, or trade explosive throws in Ink Bomb. No art skills needed—just imagination.

apps.name: Inkblade
apps.short_description: Five warlords signed a pact in cursed ink. One shinobi survived it. Raid procedural castles floor by floor, strike from the shadows or cut through the garrison, and take each lord's head at the summit. Then lead your clan in a war for sixteen provinces.

apps.name: Insanitation
apps.short_description:
It’s Chaos VS Order in this fast-paced battle against family & friends.
Will you create Chaos as a Cat - spreading fur, mayhem, & hairballs everywhere? 
Or restore Order as a Keeper - cleaning & mopping up the muck before Chaos takes over?

Pick a side & grab your kibble or gear, & claim victory.

apps.name: Inside Byte: Chapter 1
apps.short_description: Kevin Murry, pressured by financial struggles, accepts a offer to return to the fallen Harrington Entertainment. What should have been a simple job turns into a nightmare as he faces a distorted environment, where fragmented memories and a new reality test his sanity.

apps.name: It's Not Me
apps.short_description: Become a nameless Princess inside an unfinished video game from 1986. Explore, interact and choose your responses in a narrative adventure about identity and self-determination, with nine chapters and four endings shaped by your choices.

apps.name: Ittzy Fearless
apps.short_description: Ittzy Fearless is a difficult physics-based action game. Play as Ittzy the fire spirit and use your swift moves and devastating strikes to tackle chaotic waves of enemies, projectiles and explosions.

apps.name: Ium Idle Companions Odyssey
apps.short_description: Monster-collecting auto-battler desktop companion. Assemble, customize, strategize elemental synergies, craft powerful skill loadouts, and conquer regions as your squad fights autonomously in fast-paced real-time combat at the edge of your screen while you work, study, or play.

apps.name: Jigsaw Puzzles Together
apps.short_description: Solve jigsaw puzzles together at one shared table with up to 8 players. Choose from 4 to 1000 pieces, pick classic or irregular shapes, turn on rotation for a challenge, and watch the picture come together.

apps.name: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
apps.short_description: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it’s lost forever.

apps.name: Kaiju Gladiators
apps.short_description:
Enter the Arena with your Mythical Gears.
Transform into Massive Kaijus and Destroy Everything in your Path!
Topdown 2D hack and slash combat with swords, axes, spears, and all, with devastating abilities.
Duel rivals in PvP or battle through hordes of Kaiju, Hunt them all, Unlock and Upgrade Gears!

apps.name: Keybort
apps.short_description: Keybort is a clean and fluid idle / clicker game where you progress by pressing keyboard keys.

apps.name: Khanate: Fire Before Dark
apps.short_description: Historical grand strategy on the Central Asian steppe, 1646. Rule one of thirty realms, or start as a lone rider and climb to the throne, while four empires close in and grow stronger every year. Build your state and win your wars while they can still be won.

apps.name: Killing Things With Your Friends
apps.short_description: Rip limbs off mutants and use them as weapons in this chaotic co-op survival game about dark humour and dismemberment. Hack through mutant hordes, work as a team, and survive lethal challenges for profit!

apps.name: Lineup, Dark Lord! : Auto Battler
apps.short_description: "One line for battle, infinite possibilities for strategy!" Reclaim the top of the Demon Army with the ultimate combination.

apps.name: Little Legions
apps.short_description: A PvP army management auto battler. Buy units and items, share traits amongst those units in order to create powerful unit combinations.

apps.name: Lost Subject
apps.short_description: You are the result of a mysterious experiment, trapped in a dark underground facility. Solve puzzles, explore dangerous locations, unlock new characters, battle bosses, and find your way to freedom!

apps.name: Lunnitsa
apps.short_description: Lunnitsa is a 3D companion who lives on your desktop. She talks with you out loud, listens when you call her, looks at your screen if you let her and helps with tasks on your PC, always with your permission. You choose what she thinks with: the cloud or your own computer.

apps.name: Magical Girl Asterix
apps.short_description: In this puzzle JRPG, play as Magical Girl Asterix on a mission to investigate the recent kidnappings. Explore a mysterious research facility, solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and outsmart powerful enemies. Will your wit be enough to save everyone and escape?

apps.name: Mayday Vacay
apps.short_description: A physics-based co-op adventure where a relaxing boat trip turns into total chaos. Work together to sail, improvise… and keep your boat afloat.

apps.name: Mech Support
apps.short_description: Mech Support is an action focused, multitasking game, featuring frantic tower defense elements. Up to four players take control of "US Inc" engineers, tasked with defending military outposts and crafting powerful ammunition, in order to destroy waves of dastardly "THEM Co" enemy mechs.

apps.name: Meowside: Desktop Cats
apps.short_description: Adorable pixel cats live on your screen. Watch them eat, nap, and wander through daily routines. Pet them or play with a cat wand, and enjoy their company every day.

apps.name: Mixlings!
apps.short_description: What?! Desktop idle game with thousands of cards! Build your adventure team. Mixlings auto-fight monsters, idle with friends for casual fun. Fuse two cards to make unique Mixlings with surprising looks & stats. Every fusion yields unexpected new cards. Create your Mixlings team!

apps.name: MODERN CAPITAL
apps.short_description: Buy from suppliers or make it yourself? MODERN CAPITAL is a business simulation of production, retail, and investment. Run factories and stores, compete on price, quality, and brand, and expand through stocks, real estate, and company acquisitions.

apps.name: Monster Girls Dice Board
apps.short_description:
On the mysterious Mysteria Island, embark on an exciting dice adventure with charming and unique monster girls!
Use strategic board game mechanics to collect resources, buy lands, and compete in friendly matches while building heartwarming bonds and exploring the fantastical island together!

apps.name: My Own Hero Party
apps.short_description: My Own Hero Party is an incremental idle game. Build your own band of heroes, venture deep into dungeons and gather mountains of gold! Invest your earnings in a permanent talent tree, grow stronger with every expedition and fight your way to the boss.

apps.name: Neptune
apps.short_description: Neptune is a short, chapter-based, dropper and precision platformer game. Soar and explore through abandoned architecture, receive gruesome mutations, enjoy the atmosphere and banging OST, and figure out the truth of what happened on Neptune all those years ago...

apps.name: Neural Descent
apps.short_description: A 2D platformer with a twist. Jump, dash, and wall cling your way through the decaying program you have called home. You must go through rigorous courses and massive challenges to fully understand the mastermind behind your programming.

apps.name: Never Sort By Color
apps.short_description: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

apps.name: Night
apps.short_description: Night is a top-down action shooter with a security-camera look. Fight through dark, ever-changing floors, shoot, dash and execute enemies in melee, face a boss every 10 floors, and team up with up to three AI-controlled allies.

apps.name: Night of Vargold
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where you chase the wolf that eats the night and fight with building cards. Actions are not your only cost: the space left on the board is one too. A full board has to be cleared with the enemy's attacks. Dodging an attack is not always the best choice.

apps.name: NightMayor
apps.short_description: You're the Mayor. You're also a vampire. Keep your city running and your fangs hidden. Play as a literal blood-sucking politician in a darkly satirical roguelite city-management game. Balance civic duties with vampiric goals and do whatever it takes to achieve your ultimate goal - re-election.

apps.name: Ninja JaJaMaru: Yokai Night Parade
apps.short_description: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

apps.name: NOSTRA: Crystalbound
apps.short_description: An action roguelite from the world of NOSTRA. It is the year 860 of the Charter: crystal grows everywhere and no kingdom guards the roads. Take the merchants' coin as the Rune Warrior, etch runes into your abilities on every run and fight through three regions of a broken land.

apps.name: NT Jigsaws: Northern Territory, Australia
apps.short_description: A calm jigsaw and picture puzzle game made from 208 photographs of Central Australia and the Top End. Build the border, join pieces on the table, and watch a gorge or a desert sunset come together. No rush, no ads, and it saves the moment you stop.

apps.name: On Target VR Darts
apps.short_description: On Target VR Darts is a physics-based darts simulation for Oculus headsets. Play Cricket, X01 and Around the world vs AI, Freethrow and Speed Darts. Gain achievements, customize your darts, and challenge players from around the world on our Leaderboards!

apps.name: Optiminer
apps.short_description: Optiminer is a minimalist incremental about mining radioactive materials. Dig through the rock to extract raw ore and radioactive materials, then pour it all into a branching upgrade tree and go deeper.

apps.name: Orbital Defense Idle
apps.short_description: Join O.D.I. Bot and the crew as you defend your planets against an endless alien fleet in this infinite sci-fi tower defense game. Collect 78 tarot-inspired Axiom cards, unleash devastating secret weapons, and push through 20 unique worlds to uncover the mysterious force driving the invasion.

apps.name: OTO
apps.short_description: OTO is a music toy with twelve little worlds to play in. Tap a pool and it ripples out in notes. Stack stones and the tide plays them. Paint the night sky and it sings back. Just mess around and see what happens.

apps.name: Paddle Cats
apps.short_description: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

apps.name: Panzertanken
apps.short_description: Turn-based tank artillery on fully destructible pixel terrain. Command about 200 tanks from WWI to today, dig in with shovels and steel plates, and blow up enemy bunkers in five campaigns, 3 vs 3 battles against bots, hot-seat duels and online matches.

apps.name: Parametamorfose
apps.short_description: A blacksmith from another dimension confronts a post-apocalyptic Brazil in a combat-heavy 2D side-scroller, where every blow carries weight and a single mistake can be fatal.

apps.name: Paranormal Cleaner
apps.short_description: Take late-night cleaning jobs in a first-person horror game. Load up your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and take out the rubbish. When a cupboard opens by itself or an unplugged washer starts knocking, decide how much of the checklist is worth finishing.

apps.name: Paranormal Investigators
apps.short_description: Paranormal Investigators is a first-person psychological horror game. Investigate haunted locations alone or with friends, gather evidence, identify supernatural entities, and survive their hunts. But be warned: the horror adapts to you, learning your fears and reactions.

apps.name: PDR Simulator: Paintless Dent Repair
apps.short_description: Read the line board reflections, pick the right rod or glue tab, and push dents out without touching the paint. Start with a budget kit in your home garage, take jobs from the board, and build your own dent repair shop. Push too hard and you'll crack the paint.

apps.name: Pharaoh's Secrets
apps.short_description: Explore Ancient Egypt in search of its lost treasures. A relaxing low poly 3D spot-the-difference game set across beautiful, hand-crafted scenes.

apps.name: Physics Clicker
apps.short_description: A click-based incremental game themed around "physics". You will start with the most fundamental classical mechanics and gradually unlock more concepts. Through the process of easy clicking and growth, with the familiar media - PHYSICS, experience the fun of resource exploration and growth.

apps.name: Pick! Idle Mining Game
apps.short_description: Pick! Idle Mining Game is a casual incremental game that combines active mining with idle progression. Explore new mine layouts each run, unlock automation, and build an upgrade tree that changes with every Prestige level. Mine at your own pace with no timers.

apps.name: Pinballistic
apps.short_description: Welcome to your own personal power station! Travelers from across the war-torn galaxy rely on stations like yours to generate energy through pinball. In Pinballistic, each run is an opportunity to upgrade pinballs, components, and the board itself to fuel the galaxy and make some cold hard credits.

apps.name: Planet Jellham
apps.short_description: Explore an alien world using the powers of your jelly hamster friends in this free metroidvania. Run, shoot, and bounce your way to victory as you uncover the source of the thorny growth threatening the planet.

apps.name: PlanetForge Protocol
apps.short_description: This is a strategy game that combines automated base construction with real-time tower defense. Land on a harsh alien planet, construct a vast automated industrial assembly line from scratch, and transform it into a formidable front capable of withstanding a massive influx of enemies.

apps.name: Po Una: Idle Tower RPG
apps.short_description: A goddess fell, and an endless tower rose from the wound. Climb it with a party of allies that fights on its own, build the camp that keeps you going, and uncover what the tower remembers. An idle RPG whose camp keeps earning while you're away.

apps.name: PopFarm Slime
apps.short_description: You inherited a little slime ranch — and a mountain of debt. Match 3 same-color slimes to sell them and pay off the collector every round. Build your own combo engine from 130+ Tools and take on bosses and rising Pressure in this match-3 roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Portal Stories: Mel
apps.short_description:
Portal Stories: Mel is a community made, free modification for Portal 2 based in the Portal universe. 
It tells the story of Mel, who meets a new personality core and faces an undiscovered threat to the Aperture facility.

apps.name: Praktikos
apps.short_description: The King of the Underworld has abandoned the Throne. In Praktikos, the Deadly Sins fight tactical card duels on strategic boards. Collect relics, upgrade your deck, create positional combos, and prove which sin deserves to rule the Underworld.

apps.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
apps.short_description: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

apps.name: Real War: Not Fake
apps.short_description: The fake-mobile incremental arcade game now made real! Shoot enemies, increase your army, gather coins, upgrade your gear, and defeat bosses to complete levels!

apps.name: Records of the Strong: Eastern Fantasy Card Game
apps.short_description: A strategic card game set in an Eastern fantasy world. Build your own deck by combining cards from different factions, anticipate your opponent's moves, and experience a unique combat system where both players' actions unfold simultaneously.

apps.name: REMM : Space Adjutant
apps.short_description: Command a mercenary company in a living sector. Trade, fight and scheme in real-time fleet battles while empires go to war around you. Play solo or with friends over Steam, and mod everything through the Workshop.

apps.name: Retail Empire
apps.short_description: Design, build, and manage a supermarket where store layout controls what shoppers see and buy. Use customer sightlines and smart display placement to trigger impulse buys, control eye-level shelf space across 250+ products, create your own store-brand products, and maximize your profits!

apps.name: Rocket Arena
apps.short_description: Rockets rule everything in Rocket Arena, an explosive 3v3 shooter where you’re never out of the action. Master your hero’s unique rockets and abilities to rule the arena and become a champion. Let’s Rocket!

apps.name: Rogue Machines
apps.short_description: A roguelike building physics puzzle game. Buy blocks to build better machines to get the ball in the goal. Unlock more blocks, levels, and upgrades as you play more runs.

apps.name: Rome
apps.short_description: The ultimate Roman Empire simulator. The year is 27 BC, and you have become emperor. Manage the Senate, your family, the state treasury, and the provinces. Fight in battles and engage in diplomacy. A faithful replica of the entire ancient world awaits you—travel and do whatever comes to mind!

apps.name: Ruins of Aloryith
apps.short_description: Ruins of Aloryith is a third-person action roguelite. Fight through escalating waves with sword and shield, unleash player-controlled abilities, and shape your build with upgrades. Face corrupted bosses and uncover the source of the corruption.

apps.name: Sala Manager
apps.short_description: Futsal Manager RPG.

apps.name: SCRAPSCRAP
apps.short_description: You're a lone robot  that was left behind to clean up all of humanity's trash. Break down trash piece by piece and recycle them into tools, upgrades and a whole crew of helper bots. Stack up all the trash and restore the planet in this physics-driven incremental game.

apps.name: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
apps.short_description: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

apps.name: Scrub, Little Sub!
apps.short_description: Scrub, Little Sub! Boost, bounce, and barrel roll your way through diverse aquatic biomes and flooded industrial structures as you clean up the ocean in this 90's-inspired collectathon adventure!

apps.name: Seat of Power
apps.short_description: Build an ancient kingdom as the Chinese, Egyptians, Greeks or Olmecs. Grow towns, run trade routes, win over independent cities, hunt monsters and summon your god in a real-time strategy game of economy, war and diplomacy. Then lead Atlantis in its own story campaign.

apps.name: Send 'em Flying
apps.short_description: Flail your sword around, dodge attacks, learn enemy behaviors, manage your stamina and explore the infested provinces of this dangerous 1-bit world while everything tries to kill you in this top-down enemy fighter.

apps.name: Set the Records Straight
apps.short_description: Opening day is approaching and it's time to turn this big mess into a perfectly organized collection. Put a favorite record on, pour a cup of tea, and settle into the satisfaction of bringing your beloved record shop back to life, one album at a time.

apps.name: Sin Hunter
apps.short_description: A real-time deckbuilding roguelike card game with no mana cost or hand size limit! Join Hell Company as a Sin Hunter, meet four distinct demon girls, build affection through dialogue, and fight alongside them with various weapons to destroy the sins fallen into the abyss!

apps.name: Skillet
apps.short_description: Skillet is a delicious arena battler where everything is flammable and bouncy. You cannot directly attack anyone but you can definitely nudge someone into harm's way.

apps.name: Smash Dash: Demolition Run
apps.short_description: Top-down PvE looter shooter. Fight, loot, and survive—extract to keep your items and clear the stage.

apps.name: SPP: Stream Party Pack
apps.short_description: Up for a friendly challenge with your TikTok LIVE viewers? Pick one of three games. Deliver parcels, paint a canvas, or knock cubes into a pit. You set the effects for likes, follows, and gifts. Your viewers decide when to lend a hand and when to get in your way.

apps.name: Stelvyr: Colony Defense
apps.short_description: Build and defend a space colony where every unit of power and every crew assignment matters. Expand production, research new technologies, shape the battlefield with walls and weapons, and adapt your strategy against alien swarms across nine campaign operations.

apps.name: Stormbox
apps.short_description: Play as Pip the Penguin, a storm chaser on a voxel island where any sky can spawn a tornado. Drive, fly and deploy gadgets to film twisters up close, collect every storm as a Storm Card, and watch panicked towns and villagers scramble as the storm closes in.

apps.name: Super Tag
apps.short_description: Tag, with super powers! Super Tag is a 2D chase platformer: swing, blink and wall-jump away from the endless hord, or hunt down your friends in multiplayer mode.

apps.name: Sushi Go Party!
apps.short_description:
Order up! 

Grab delicious sushi dishes and collect winning combinations in the award-winning board game, Sushi Go Party! 

With colourful characters, simple rules and plenty of tasty tactical twists, Sushi Go Party! serves up culinary competition for newcomers and seasoned strategists alike!

apps.name: Swarmkeeper
apps.short_description: Exploit an abomination of bees to destroy your adversaries. Swarmkeeper is a 2D linear Zelda-like, with a twist of Cult of the Lamb, that follows a tale as old as time: Your former business partners have dropped your services and you must seek revenge. You’ll never forget your first sting.

apps.name: Swelter
apps.short_description: Swelter is a story-driven mod set several years before the events of Half-Life 2. It explores the internal tensions within the Resistance during their rebellion against the Combine in a post-Soviet Central Asian city, encircled by the scorching steppe.

apps.name: Switcheroo
apps.short_description: A kangaroo named Jade escapes from an evil mad scientist who's obsessed with color! Along the way, she'll hop past vibrant obstacles, kick pesky robots out of the way, and use her new color-switching powers to solve the lab's mysterious puzzles.

apps.name: Table Tennis Club Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own table tennis club. Rent out tables, stock a pro shop, craft custom rackets, and grow the club day by day. Recruit players, train your team and climb the ladder against rival clubs on match night.

apps.name: Taimanin Asagi 2
apps.short_description:
Taimanin Asagi, the legendary anti-demon ninja, returns in the second installment of this classic visual novel series!

Asagi and Sakura head to Tokyo Kingdom, a lawless district overrun with demons and criminals, to determine the whereabouts of their fellow Taimanin who have gone missing in action.

apps.name: TAIMANIN RPG Extasy
apps.short_description: super-popular Taimanin RPG is now available on Steam! The Taimanin take the stage in a classic turn-based RPG! Commander Skills, Formations, and Ultimate Skills... Make good use of them and be victorious! Battle alongside Taimanin whenever you want! From this day forth, you're a Taimanin!

apps.name: Tales From the Herd
apps.short_description: Tales From the Herd is an upcoming life simulation game that takes place in an abandoned pony village; one that you and a friend take charge in the restoration of. It features rich character customization, dynamic dialogue, and a strong focus on atmosphere and story telling.

apps.name: TCG Shop Life
apps.short_description: Run your dream TCG shop! Stock shelves, open card packs, customize your store, and hire staff. Collect cards, build powerful decks, and even compete in tournaments all the way to the World Championship!

apps.name: Team Fortress 2 Classified
apps.short_description: Team Fortress 2 Classified is a new Team Fortress 2 experience built on its original inspirations and tone. Updated with refreshed visuals, new gamemodes and maps, new weapons, new teams, and a portly oil baron.

apps.name: Temple of Revi
apps.short_description: Travel with Revi through the lands devastated by corruption, putting colorful magic generators in place to bring color and life back to the nature.

apps.name: Teraton : City Destroyer
apps.short_description: Take to the skies, hurl cars, and bring buildings crashing down in a single-player superhero action sandbox. Wreak havoc in a sprawling metropolis, face an escalating police response, and unlock new powers between runs.

apps.name: Test Your Luck: Gacha Simulator
apps.short_description: Welcome to GachaOS, the premier gacha gaming platform for whales! Play a gauntlet of incremental gacha games with Moby, our helpful Gacha Assistant. Build your fortune, then burn it all pulling characters, ripping packs, or opening crates. Unlucky? With GachaOS, turn your misfortune into fortune!

apps.name: That's My Life
apps.short_description: Build one life across an entire connected world. Choose from hundreds of careers, run businesses from raw materials to retail, invest, own property, raise a family, enter politics or crime, and deal with active NPCs and lasting consequences.

apps.name: The Final Ideology
apps.short_description: Lead your faction through the Third Cold War in this turn-based grand strategy. Millennia after the destruction of Earth, survivors of the Communist and Capitalist superpowers have forged enormous multi-planetary factions that have recently re-discovered one another. Which side will you take?

apps.name: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
apps.short_description: A mysterious disease is turning people into picture books. When her sister contracts Paper Mortis, Mono must do everything she can to save her—even if that means making a deal with a veritable devil.

apps.name: The Hearth That Waits
apps.short_description: Build your whole party around one shared dice roll. Every companion reads the same result through their own runes, then acts in turn to chain combos. Plan your team in town, then set out on a warm, light-hearted fantasy adventure.

apps.name: The Last Of Morvein
apps.short_description: You are an aristocrat, the last survivor of Morvein. Explore a dark metropolis of Gothic architecture and Victorian elegance. Battle hellish creatures and uncover the mystery behind the fall of a city where death was only the beginning of the nightmare.

apps.name: The Myth of Might: A Lone Wolf
apps.short_description: A dungeon-crawler adventure where your mission is to rescue a kidnapped president.

apps.name: The New Year's School
apps.short_description: The world's first cooperative survival quiz! Face challenging questions in this pixel-art horror JRPG and survive through 7 fields of knowledge with your friends!

apps.name: The Odds Are Stacked Against Us
apps.short_description: PULL THE LEVER! In this tower defense roguelite, a slot machine deals your towers and thousands of tiny walking coins are coming for your base. Hit lines, merge towers, rain rockets and lightning, and watch the horde explode into gold. Jackpot or bust!

apps.name: The Reason Behind
apps.short_description: The Reason Behind is a third-person detective game set in a 1954 Noir Providence. Investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, connect clues, and uncover hidden truths. Experience a deep, mature story filled with complex characters, dark secrets, and psychological mystery.

apps.name: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow
apps.short_description: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

apps.name: The Silver Witch
apps.short_description: Dead, and now an angel—but Heaven's rules feel wrong. Jailed for forbidden Hell magic, Uriel escapes with Ailena, a girl met in prison, to start a second life in Hell, the Land of Demons. A two-person turn-based dark fantasy RPG in an afterlife where neither salvation nor judgment can be trusted.

apps.name: The Sword Wizard
apps.short_description: A 2D action-adventure game through a fun and silly story. Use magic to launch swords at enemies. Explore maps to find more swords of various types and questionable designs. Magically combine swords into new powers to unleash even more swords at enemies.

apps.name: They Ate Grandma
apps.short_description: Hit the road with Grandma in a top-down zombie survival adventure. Scavenge for fuel and food, repair your car, and kick some zombie ass. You find the ingredients, Grandma does the cooking. Just make sure she doesn’t end up on the menu.

apps.name: This new City-Builder game
apps.short_description: Use the day to train soldiers, craft and equip weapons, and build defensive buildings, so that your city will not be run over during the night!

apps.name: Tilelings!
apps.short_description:
A competitive party game that blends puzzles and action!
Online multiplayer for up to 4 players!
Challenge your friends in a variety of game modes that put both your puzzle-solving skills and action skills to the test!

apps.name: Tinplate Scramble
apps.short_description: Two factions battle across land and sky in Tinplate Scramble. Win firefights and melees on foot, pilot a fighter or hovercraft into the fray, and tip the scales in open skirmishes and handcrafted missions involving 100+ fielded units.

apps.name: Too Lucky to Die
apps.short_description: Too Lucky To Die brings players together at one table for a deadly showdown. Each round, a mysterious maid serves up a random, lethal challenge. Use your cards and your role’s unique abilities to cheat death in one twisted game after another!

apps.name: Toxicode
apps.short_description: Twenty shifts in a back-alley clinic. Most patients carry a strain that rots tissue or hijacks implants, every test raises your Bio-Load, and every wrong treatment sets off a complication. Keep the district alive, then diagnose yourself.

apps.name: Trainfort
apps.short_description: Trainfort is an open-world co-op survival crafting game. As a dwarf nomad, hit the road of this post-apocalyptic world with your bearded mates. Build a moving steam engine, pack your base with you, and explore the wilderness. The country is big, your legs are short, but you gotta keep moving!

apps.name: Trifoil
apps.short_description: A puzzle game about drawing lines that cross, merge, and interact in unique ways. Uncover secrets, decipher symbols, and trace paths that satisfy every rule.

apps.name: Turbidity
apps.short_description: Turbidity is a surreal dungeon crawler where you are tasked with the collection of 3,000 fingernails by your God, the Striver of Atrocity.

apps.name: Twilight Park
apps.short_description:
Twilight Park is a retro puzzle/escape room game. 
You were invited to an amusement park, it was supposed to be fun.
But soon, you realized you were trapped in the park.
Can you escape the park? Investigate the environment, find useful items, solve puzzles, and escape the park!

apps.name: Typers Combat 2: Type Harder
apps.short_description: Every correct key is a punch. Out-type your rival to land the hits, then end the match with a brutal cinematic execution, X-ray bone breaks included. A 3D typing fighter with a first-person story mode, 10 bonus stages and a fighter you build yourself.

apps.name: UHL
apps.short_description: "Uhl" is a Korean folklore-inspired fantasy MMORPG where forgotten tales come to life. Explore a world of spirits, mythical creatures, and fractured destinies. Choose your faction, forge your own path, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious book that records every fate.

apps.name: Underground Business
apps.short_description: Underground Business is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for a rural town at a pizzeria kiosk. Take orders, cook pizza, investigate the suspicious pizzeria underground and run for your life in high-intensity chases!

apps.name: Vexillord
apps.short_description: Command a company of mercenaries through fully automatic battles against the Orc King and the Demon King. Gear every soldier piece by piece, set the formation, plant the banner and watch the war unfold. Win and they grow stronger. Lose and someone may never come back.

apps.name: Warriors of Legend: Three Kingdoms
apps.short_description: During the Eastern Han Dynasty, Many heroes were fighting for control of the land. Experience the exciting tale of the Three Kingdoms era as you play as over 20 playable characters in this 1 vs 1000 action game.

apps.name: Watch Your Focus!
apps.short_description:
Don't let the mysterious lady, ‘Blank’, steal your gaze.
A casual drop-puzzle game where you merge matching gems to create bigger ones. Maintain your focus in a limited space and aim for the highest score.

apps.name: Westbound Legacy
apps.short_description: WESTBOUND LEGACY is a single-player Western adventure set in 1875. Mount your horse and travel through a frontier landscape of ranchland, pine forests and open meadows.

apps.name: Whispers Of The Crypt
apps.short_description: Whispers of the Crypt is a dark atmospheric RPG set deep beneath a world that’s forgotten its heroes. The Starbound have vanished, yet the forge still burns. You awaken in a lost tomb with no memory, guided by whispers that seem to know your name and your destiny.

apps.name: Whittle Warband
